correctness.rationale: The step set consists of vu^T with u^Tv=0 and exactly q-1 parametrizations. Fourier summation over the orthogonal hyperplane gives the exact projective-eigenline multiplier, with character labels modulo scalar matrices. For a unique maximal rational eigenspace of codimension c<n/2, Gaussian binomial choices of the eigenspace and injective quotient maps give N_{n,c}=[n choose c]_q prod_{j=0}^{c-1}(q^n-q^j). Each fixed-c contribution at time n+s tends to q^{-c²-2cs}/prod(1-q^-j), and uniform tail estimates for c up to and beyond n/3 justify the infinite series. Rank(X_t)<=t while a Haar-traceless matrix rarely has corank >=a, proving the earlier total variation side; chi-square convergence bounds the later side. An independent F2 n=3 checker enumerated all 256 character classes and all 21 steps, verified 256 exact Fourier eigenline multipliers and the 49 classes with eigenhyperplane of dimension 2. Finite checks do not establish cutoff.
residual_risks: The statement assumes fixed q and n tending to infinity, not simultaneous large-field scaling.
